storyCards.headline: Smiling Faces Sometimes: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Undisputed Truth's "Smiling Faces Sometimes" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 18 weeks on the chart.

Smiling Faces Sometimes was released in 1971.

"Smiling Faces Sometimes" by The Undisputed Truth.

Chart story — peaked at #3 on the Hot 100.
